S1.1_link_colors.notes: Well-defined. WCAG validation tools specified. Edge case: different link protocols not mentioned.

S1.2_conversation_colors.notes: Good, but Coblis testing adds complexity. Recommendation: create color palette guide for consistency.

S1.3_unread_pinned.notes: Missing: Does marking unread auto-clear on view? DB migration rollback steps not defined.

S2.1_fix_zindex.notes: Simple, well-defined. BLOCKER status for S2.2 very clear. Recommendation: emphasize in Wave 2 section.

S2.2_status_filter.notes: Missing: How does filter combine with search? What if user filters to stage with 0 items? Counts update real-time?

S3.1_drag_drop.notes: CRITICAL: Firefox testing mentioned but not in AC. Performance baseline not defined (how to measure FPS?). Edge cases missing: same column drag, drag to invalid zone.

S4.1_deduplication.notes: Excellent detail on data safety. Missing: fuzzy match examples (when does 0.95 threshold match?). Rollback procedure not defined.
